correctness.rationale: For every d>=2, nondegenerate simplex S, s>0 and 0<beta<=min(s,1)^d, each translate of sS has unique affine facet thresholds a_i summing to 1-s, with relative overlap (1-sum_i max(a_i,0))_+^d. The overlap constraint is sum positive parts <=h=1-beta^(1/d). For each j, a_j<=h and equality is achievable by setting a_j=h and distributing the sum 1-s-h<=0 over the other facets. Thus intersection over all admissible translates is exactly {lambda_i>=h}, independent of scale beyond admissible beta. Barycentric sum=1 proves the empty/centroid/homothetic simplex trichotomy at beta_c=(d/(d+1))^d and scale threshold s=d/(d+1); volume ratio ((d+1)beta^(1/d)-d)^d. The independent sample verifies positive-part budget and overlap including admissible endpoints, whereas the analytic facet supremum proves all dimensions and continuous parameters.
